text: The instrument cluster in Aventro Motors vehicles is designed to inform the driver about the status of various vehicle systems. Each symbol or indicator light provides information on system performance, potential malfunctions, or urgent warnings requiring immediate action.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts

text: Below is a list of common warning alerts you may see in Aventro Motors cars, along with their meanings:
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts

text: - Meaning: Indicates a problem with the engine or emissions control system. Immediate diagnosis is recommended.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 1. Engine Warning Light (Check Engine)

text: - Meaning: The battery is not charging properly. This could signal alternator failure, battery issues, or wiring problems.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 2. Battery Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Low oil pressure detected. Stop the engine and check oil levels to avoid engine damage.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 3. Oil Pressure Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Possible issues with the brake system such as low fluid, worn brake pads, or handbrake engaged.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 4. Brake System Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Indicates a malfunction in the Anti-lock Braking System. Normal brakes may function, but ABS will not.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 5. ABS Warning Light

text: - Meaning: There may be a problem with the airbag system; airbags may not deploy in a collision.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 6. Airbag Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Engine is overheating. Stop the vehicle in a safe place and check coolant levels.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 7. Coolant Temperature Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Transmission malfunction, possible overheating or system fault. Immediate attention required.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 8. Transmission Warning Light

text: - Meaning: One or more tires have low pressure or there’s a sensor malfunction.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 9. Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) Light

text: - Meaning: Indicates that the traction control system is currently in use or there is a system fault.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 10. Traction Control Warning Light

text:
- Symbol: ESP/BAS
- Meaning: Problem with Electronic Stability Program/Brake Assist System.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 11. ESP/BAS Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Malfunction in the power steering system; steering may feel heavy.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 12. Power Steering Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Low fuel level; refuel soon.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 13. Fuel Level Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Indicates pre-heating of diesel engine or a fault in the glow plug system.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 14. Glow Plug Warning Light (Diesel)

text:
- Symbol: Hybrid/EV Symbol
- Meaning: Malfunction in the hybrid or electric powertrain. Service required.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 15. Hybrid/Electric System Warning Light

text:
- Symbol: Spanner/Wrench symbol
- Meaning: Indicates that regular maintenance is due.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 16. Service Reminder Light

text: - Meaning: Driver or passenger (depending on sensor) seatbelt is not fastened.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 17. Seatbelt Reminder Light

text:
- Symbol: Car with Doors Open
- Meaning: One or more doors are not fully closed.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 18. Door Ajar Warning Light

text: - Meaning: Windshield washer fluid is low.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 19. Washer Fluid Warning Light

text: - Meaning: High beam headlights are turned on. (This is informational, not a warning.)
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > 20. High Beam Indicator

text:
- If any red warning light appears, stop the vehicle in a safe location as soon as possible and consult your Aventro Motors dealer or the owner's manual.
- Yellow/amber lights indicate caution; check the system soon.
- For hybrid/electric models, specific alerts will provide system details regarding battery, charging, and electric drive functions.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > Important Notes

text: Contact your nearest Aventro Service Center or call Aventro Support at +91 124 1234567.
path: Instrument Cluster Warning Alerts > For Assistance
